mod1.title: Bypass Shortener Script
mod1.description: Automatically bypass common link shorteners and direct you to the final page instantly. Works in all major browsers.
mod1.installationGuide:
### Installation Guide

1. **Prerequisite**: Install a user script manager extension like [Tampermonkey](https://www.tampermonkey.net/) or [Violentmonkey](https://violentmonkey.github.io/) on your web browser.
2. **Installation**: Click the **Download / Install** button above. Your script manager will automatically detect the `.user.js` file and prompt you to install it.
3. **Confirmation**: Enable the script in your extension dashboard.
4. **Usage**: Visit any shortener link. The script will run in the background, skip timers, and redirect you directly to the destination.

*If you face issues with a specific shortener site, try clearing your browser cache or updating the script to the latest version.*

mod2.title: Retro Runner Unlimited Keys Mod
mod2.description: Unlock infinite coins, diamonds, and keys in Retro Runner. Play with all character skins unlocked from the beginning.
mod2.installationGuide:
### Installation Guide

1. **Uninstall Original App**: First, completely uninstall the official Retro Runner game from your Android/iOS device to prevent package signature conflicts.
2. **Download Mod APK**: Click the **Install** button to download the signed mod package (.apk / .ipa).
3. **Enable Unknown Sources**: Go to **Settings** > **Security** > and enable **Install Apps from Unknown Sources**.
4. **Install**: Open your file explorer, locate the downloaded file, and tap it to install.
5. **Launch**: Open the game. You will see infinite balance indicators in the main menu.

*WARNING: Do not connect your official Google Play Games / Game Center account to avoid potential server-side bans.*

mod3.title: Ad-Blocker Pro DNS Script
mod3.description: Block native video ads, sponsored banners, and tracking scripts system-wide without draining battery or CPU.
mod3.installationGuide:
### System Setup Instructions

This script runs locally as a proxy filter on your router or system DNS settings.

#### For Windows/macOS:
1. Open your connection settings.
2. Locate the **IPv4 / DNS Properties** section.
3. Paste the DNS IP addresses listed in the config download.
4. Save settings and clear your browser DNS cache.

#### For Mobile (Android/iOS):
1. Go to **Network Settings** > **Private DNS**.
2. Set the private DNS provider hostname to the address provided in our files.
3. Save configuration. Enjoy ad-free browsing across all apps.

mod4.title: FPS Booster Config for Sandbox 3D
mod4.description: Optimize engine textures, adjust CPU thread allocation, and fix rendering stutters to boost FPS by up to 60%.
mod4.installationGuide:
### Configuration Guide

1. Download the booster config file (`engine.ini`).
2. Open your device's file manager and locate the directory:
   `Android/data/com.sandbox3d.game/files/settings/` or your platform equivalent.
3. Backup your existing `engine.ini` file by renaming it to `engine.ini.bak`.
4. Paste the downloaded `engine.ini` into the directory.
5. Launch the game and navigate to Graphics settings to see new unlocked high-performance profiles.

*Note: If graphics appear too blurry, you can adjust the resolution scale value manually inside the file using any text editor.*
